en: The postcard displays a black-and-white panoramic photograph of a German town with houses, trees, and a prominent church with a tall spire in the distance. There are mountains or hills in the background. On the front side, the text 'Gruss aus Bad Pyrmont.' indicates greetings from Bad Pyrmont, and 'Totalansicht' means 'general view.' The reverse side is formatted for mailing with printed lines and classic German blackletter text ('Deutsche Reichspost. Postkarte.') and a stamp from a museum ('Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont').
